conceptual assets.concept: Stored general-purpose register values (the register file contents read out as rs1_o/rs2_o/rs3_o)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL implements a register-file signal reg_file that is written from rd_i and read to produce the module's operand outputs. In the non-RST_EN (FPGA) variant the clocked process performs: on rising_edge(clk_i) if (rf_we = '1') then reg_file(to_integer(unsigned(opa_addr(addr_bits_c-1 downto 0)))) <= rd_i; end if; rs1_o <= reg_file(...); rs2_o <= reg_file(...);. In the RST_EN (ASIC) variant per-register processes perform reg_file(i) <= rd_i when unsigned(ctrl_i.rf_rd(...)) = to_unsigned(i,...) and ctrl_i.rf_wb_en = '1', and the rf_read process assigns rs1_o/rs2_o <= reg_file(...). The outputs (rs1_o, rs2_o and, when enabled, rs3_o) therefore directly reflect reg_file contents; unauthorized modification or incorrect updates of those stored values would violate the implemented read results, establishing Integrity.

conceptual assets.concept: Register-file write control decision (the gating and index selection that determines when and which reg_file entry is updated)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL computes and uses write-eligibility and index-selection logic that determines whether a reg_file entry is updated. In the non-RST_EN variant rf_we is computed as rf_we <= (ctrl_i.rf_wb_en and (not rd_zero)) or ctrl_i.rf_zero_we and the process uses rf_we to guard reg_file(...) <= rd_i; opa_addr is assigned from ctrl_i fields and is used as the target index. In the RST_EN variant each reg_file(i) process updates when unsigned(ctrl_i.rf_rd(...)) = to_unsigned(i,...) and ctrl_i.rf_wb_en = '1'. These control expressions implement the module's write-eligibility; incorrect or forged values of these controls (or their computed decisions) would cause incorrect register updates, establishing Integrity.
